تعتادين (form VIII)
# تَعْتَادِينَ (taʕtādīna) /taʕ.taː.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِعْتَادَ (iʕtāda)
# تُعْتَادِينَ (tuʕtādīna) /tuʕ.taː.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَادَ (iʕtāda)
